Scripts.OnLoad:
self:RegisterForClicks("AnyUp")
self:HookScript("OnEnter", function(self) if not self.unit then return end
local unit = self.unit C_Timer.After(0, function() if not UnitExists(unit) then return end GameTooltip_SetDefaultAnchor(GameTooltip, self) GameTooltip:SetUnit(unit) GameTooltip:Show() end) end)
self:HookScript("OnLeave", function(self) GameTooltip:Hide() end)
if MRF_OnUnitFrameLoad then MRF_OnUnitFrameLoad(self) end
Scripts.OnAttributeChanged: if name == "unit" then self.unit = value if MRF_OnUnitChanged then MRF_OnUnitChanged(self, value) end end
